command: cd /code && Rscript -e 'load("../data/ratingData5"); ExclList5 <- c(4,5,7,13,30,66,160,116); ratingData5 <- subset(ratingData5, !(ParticipantNumber %in% ExclList5)); ratingData5$correspondingTime <- as.factor(ratingData5$correspondingTime); ratingData5$USval <- ifelse(substr(as.character(ratingData5$correspondingUS), 1, 1) == "p", "positive", "negative"); ratingData5$USval <- as.factor(ratingData5$USval); ratingData5Aggr <- aggregate(likingRating ~ ParticipantNumber * USval * correspondingTime, ratingData5, mean); ratingData5AggrW <- reshape(ratingData5Aggr, idvar=c("ParticipantNumber","correspondingTime"), timevar="USval", direction="wide"); ratingData5AggrW$EC <- ratingData5AggrW$likingRating.positive - ratingData5AggrW$likingRating.negative; print(with(ratingData5AggrW, tapply(EC, correspondingTime, mean))); print(with(ratingData5AggrW, tapply(EC, correspondingTime, median)));'
